query:
SELECT
            a.slug,
            a.name,
            COALESCE(
                JSONB_AGG(
                    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                        'redirect_uris', o.redirect_uris,
                        'client_secret_hash', o.client_secret_hash
                    )
                ),
                '{}'::jsonb
            ) AS "oidc: Json<ApplicationOidc>"
        FROM applications a
        LEFT JOIN applications_oidc o ON o.slug = a.slug
        GROUP BY a.slug, a.name;
